translation.name: Waom Yesu Wane Sigi Maep Don

content: Yesu Wakonge
Naso yewao kepe ware ware Sisa Augustusŋo raki, Roman kepeo gavaman ŋei ŋerep korop eŋetene qe dapot okanwarekoi.
Urata yaline alakan mi mamaine. Naso yewao Kirinius eŋe Siria kepeo ware ware suaine gekimo, kuneŋine kiekkoi.
Pakimo, ea wane eŋetene qe dapot okanongei wane, ŋei ŋerep korop wakon wakon mateno ariwarekoi.
Ariwareuso, Yosep eŋe Dawit wane ŋosa wili wiliineŋo Galili kepeo, Nazaret matko ŋine, yale waka wie more, Yuda kepeo ŋei waom Dawit wane wako wakon matine Betlehem, yewa arike.
Eŋe ŋerep biŋekine Mariarop eŋetetne qekei wane medep ŋat korop iwenkaki arikoik.
Ari Betlehem matko lotkeuk, so Maria medep mayakane nasoine bomileke,
pakiso, alakan medepine ma more, laplapŋo kawetka more, bulamakau kudeo birakaki pake, ŋei edo lobo mat mo watkewarekoi, wane ere qeka more, so bulamakau eŋane matko waket metkoik.
Lama Ware Ware So Aŋelo
Kepe mat yewaoka ŋei natne eŋe goigo lamakopene wareone metkoi,
pakiso, Waom wane aŋelo maneŋo eŋano wakongi, Waom wane qilauneŋo qelaŋanonge, pakiso, eŋe ka more zok kaetonge.
Pakiso, aŋeloŋo edane rake, “Mi kaet ŋungep! Na iwa ŋinane wet maep don magemaile, ea wane weleine ŋei ŋerep korop ŋinano wet pesek wakoniake,
ukude kaiwe iwao Dawit wane matko medep ŋei wakonmaike, eŋe ŋine ma menaŋŋuniake, eŋetine Kristo Waom!
Pakimo, ŋidanbe detpi! Ŋine medep nigatne abubu laplapŋo kawetka kawetkaine, bulamakau kudeo paki, ari maratkaikei.”
Yale rakiso, yewaoka qeliwo ŋine aŋelo magu edo ikopka aŋelo kimaenano lewage, eŋet kito more Anutu ma wakakoi,

content.text: “Bakom mawa mawa Anutu weti qeliwo so kepeo ŋei kima mauluk okanonmaike, eŋano peam wakonmaike!”

content: Aŋelo eŋe qeliwo zinge wawareuso, lama ware ware eŋe iwa yale ra more aukoi, “Ŋene Betlehem matko wa more, Waomŋo tanik wakongi ŋedanmaike, yewa kaŋem.”
Yale ra more, ikopka arikoi, ari Maria so Yosep maratore so, kau medep abubu laplapŋo kawetka kawetkaine, bulamakau kudeo pake.
Ka more, medep wane don kisi aŋeloŋo edange, yewa ra wakongoi.
Pakiso, lama ware ware eŋane piwo ŋine don kisiwa detkoi, eŋe korop welelepkekoi.
Mariaŋo yemo don yewa wetke more, dere detsorok qesorok okane geke.
Pakiso, lama ware ware eŋe aŋelo edange, rokop kakoi, so detkoi, ea wane zinge more, eŋet kito more Anutu bakomine kitokoi.
Yesu Eŋetne Orakoi
Soda qoeki, kaiwe 8 okangiso, medep yaine solaine kitareso, eŋetine Yesu orakoi, eŋet yewa mo medep eŋe mi wakongi, aŋeloŋo ra wakonge.
Maria So Yosep Eto Yesu Anutu Bakom Urumgo Ma Wakoik.
Pakiso, Mose wane ra rokop don pake, yewa Mariaŋo teweke more titi ge more, sola ma more Yosep korop medep Yerusalem matko ma wa more, so Waom wane biŋek qekoi.
Waom wane ra rokop dongo iwa yale qeko, “Medep ŋei mikepka wakonbi, Waom wane biŋek qekei.”
Ere yale waka Waom wane soe soep mitkeik wane, ra rokop dongo naŋi baluse etke me baluse nigatne etke, ma more arikoik.
Naso yewaoka, ŋei mane, eŋetne Simeon eŋe Yerusalem matko geke, eŋe koboboine Anutu ewino kito ge more, Israel ŋei magu menaŋgei wane toma geke, pakiso, Asu Koboboineŋo weneŋ kotino geke.
Ge more, don iwa yale ra wakone olatke, “Ge ikop mi seukkene, ge ge more, deŋoneŋo Waom wane Mesia wakongi kaikene.”
Pakiso, Asuŋo Simeon talekaki, Anutu Wane Bakom Urumgo wake, wakiso, Mariaŋo Yosep ere ra rokop don teweke more, Yesu medep yewaka ma more Anutu Wane Bakom Urumgo ma wakoik.
Pakiso, Simeonŋo Yesu medep ma more koaŋka okoraso, Anutu bakomine kito more rake,

content.text: “O, Waom, ge ukude donŋone rakone yewa warekamaine, ea wane qelit ŋeiŋone maine birakanom peamgo ariake.
Na dene qomineŋo geŋane medep kaulukmaile, eŋe baŋ ŋado ŋei ŋerep ma menaŋ oniake.
Ge mauluk mauluk medep ea kepe baŋem ŋei ŋerep korop eŋane deeneŋo kaikei wane matuzupke more ma wakonkamaine,
medep yewaŋo qelaŋ eŋano geŋane qelaŋanŋo wetene ma qelaŋanmaike, ŋo ŋei ŋerewekopŋone Israel eŋane eŋet biŋekene ma wiemaike.”

content: Simeonŋo medep wane don yale rakimo, naga magaine ere detpik manerop wawaine okangi, oŋaetne qaeke.

Simeonŋo mosopone, so medep nagaine Maria olale rake, “Detmaine! Anutuŋo medep iwa birakake, eŋano Israel ŋei poripkekei wane raraine, natne eŋe eŋano kito sorodoge kito yau more ket rasu warekei, ŋo natne eŋe eŋano kito togole more menaŋgei. So ŋei loutne numaene leŋleŋinane ma ket biraka zok manerop okankaikei,
ea wane ŋei loutne eŋane kineene wakoniake, so geŋone wet borik tabaineŋo qomŋone rasu tabaeake, tanik yaline wakoniake.”
Pakimo, sele ŋerep mane geke, eŋetne Ana, Panuel wane borasine, Aser wane tegoo ŋine, eŋe natewenino ŋei ma more geki, koma 7 okangi mo, ŋaone seukke.
Seukkimo, eŋe mala okane ge ari mage komaine 84 rutupke, so sele okange, eŋe Anutu wane Bakom Urumgo tako rakot ruo kaiwe, wawa ket ket okane, so Anutu wane ra wage, so meŋen meŋen urata mageke.
Naso, yewaoka eŋe Anutu wane Bakom Urumgo wa more so Anutu bakomine kitoke, so Yesu medep wane don kisiine ra wakone, ŋei ŋerep korop Anutuŋo Yerusalem koso siwot oniakane toma pakoi, eŋe edange.
Yosep Eŋe Koso Nazaret Zingeke
Yosep ŋo Maria ere Waom wane ra rokop dongo raraine yalewa okanbik qoekiso koso zinge more Nazaret mateno, Galili kepeo arikoik.
Yewa geukso, Anutuŋo Yesu medep kito qesiŋ okankaki, sua togole okangi, dereretine suake. Pakiso, Anutu wane mosopŋo kutino wa pake.
Yesu Medep Komaine 12 Okangi Yerusalem Anutu Wane Bakom Urumgo Wake
Maria so Yosep ere peada baŋem aŋelo loloŋon loloŋon peada wane Yerusalem ari okanmaŋkoik.
Pakiso, Yesu medep mo komaine 12 okangiso, weneŋ iwenkauk so aŋelo loloŋon loloŋon peada wane Yerusalem matko wakoi.
Wa geu peada qoekiso, Maria ŋo Yosep ere Yesu medep kito qokkauk, Yerusalem matko metkiso, eretneka zinge arikoik.
Ari more ŋei ŋerep magu natne eŋerop alakane arimi ra, kimakopetne eŋane keueno zuaŋka arimageuk, ruo kereke.
Kepe qaekiso zuaŋka mageuk borikiso, koso zinge Yerusalem matko zuaŋka arikoik.
Ari zuaŋka geuk, kaiwe karewe okangiso, ari Anutu wane Bakom Urumgo metki, wa more maratkakoik. Eŋe yewa Yuda kito ebo ebon eŋane keueno mere, don rau dere so kinane ra qeson okanonge.
Pakiso, ŋei yewa weneŋ metkoi, eŋe kau paki qeso qesonene ewekineka mainge okange, yewa wane oŋaene zok qaeki, don dereretinane manerop welelepkekoi.
Eŋane keueno metki, naga magaine ere ka more oŋaetne qaeke, pakiso nagaineŋo olale rake, “Giponne, ge onoka wane yale okanŋotmaine, pakimo magaŋonerop ŋere qom sua zok okane zuaŋgane gemaite?”
rakiso etane rake, “Ŋire onoka wane zok zuaŋnane gemamik? Na Maganane matko gekalane raraine yewa ŋire mi detmamik me?”
Yale rakimo, ere don yewa wane kine mi detlukkoik.
Pakiso, eŋe naga magaine ererop weneŋ Nazaret matko zinge arikoi, yewa naga magaine erane aŋaetne teweke geke, ŋo nagaineŋo yemo donine detke, rokop wetino motki paki wetke geke.
Pakiso, Yesu eŋe dereretine so solaine, weneŋ sua togole okangiso, Anutu so ŋei weneŋ eŋe kau menaŋge.
